description: For a set of natural numbers, computable decidability is equivalent to having a total recursive natural-number characteristic function with \(1\) for membership and \(0\) for nonmembership.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.decidable_iff_characteristic (A : ℕ → Prop) :
  ComputablePred A ↔
    ∃ f, Computable f ∧ ∀ (x : ℕ), f x = Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.indicator A x
